entries.name: ip
entries.description:
Sets the local IP address the proxy binds to, for hosts with more than one network interface. Given as the second positional argument on the command line: qwfwd [port [ip]] (a port must be given first). An address given here overrides any net_ip value set in the config file.

Default: 0.0.0.0, which binds to all available network interfaces.
Set by: command line (second positional argument).
See also: net_ip.

entries.name: port
entries.description:
Sets the UDP port the proxy listens on. Given as the first positional argument on the command line: qwfwd [port [ip]]. A port given here overrides any net_port value set in the config file.

Default: 30000 (when no port is given on the command line).
Set by: command line (first positional argument).
See also: net_port.
